title: Timescape distances

baseline.label: Two-scale dust tracker
baseline.scope: Retain the source timescape background and observer prescription. Spatially flat ΛCDM is a comparison cosmology for SN fits, not a retained physical sector or a substitution for timescape.
baseline.parameters_reason: No candidate input set is registered. Source illustrative or fitted values are not adopted as prospect parameters.

cosmology.gravity: Statistical Buchert averaging of Einstein equations for dust, plus an operational clock/observer prescription. The effective metrics are explicitly not exact Einstein-equation solutions.
cosmology.geometry: Spatially flat wall regions, negatively curved voids, evolving volume fractions, volume-average time t and wall proper time tau. The dressed null cone is not a global flat FLRW geometry.
components: Retained coarse-grained pressureless matter/dust; this distance model does not independently resolve a baryon/CDM split.
Bare curvature and kinematic backreaction enter averaged closure.
No homogeneous Λ or dark-energy fluid in the timescape dust closure; radiation-era perturbation/recombination physics is not supplied by this SN model.
modifications: Two-region averaging and lapse dt/dtau distinguish bare from dressed H and matter parameters.
Tracker specialization supplies the proposed distance test; source general solutions remain broader.
cosmology.background: Bare matter+curvature+backreaction closure and wall-observer dressing are linked by source Eqs.(7)-(11). Verified tracker f_v(t), lapse and observed z(t) are still required; no FLRW time-redshift substitution is permissible.
cosmology.perturbations: No closed general perturbation/CMB/line-of-sight system is admitted for this candidate. Effective average metrics do not establish a unique underlying spacetime or all observations.
observables: Minimal test: dressed luminosity distance and conditional common-object SN reduction/cut sensitivity.
Bare and dressed H/q may be compared only with their respective clock conventions.
Approximate source CMB/BAO matching carries unreworked standard-model reduction assumptions.

scope: Test analytic versus independently integrated tracker distances with model-consistent redshift mapping.
Lost scope: general Buchert initial conditions, exact spacetime, local line-of-sight structure and full SN retraining/selection.
Conditional relative SN comparison does not establish absolute H0 or causal reduction bias.
unknowns: Primary tracker mapping/reference and c restoration.
Common-event photometry, calibrations, extinction priors, selection, covariance and nuisance normalization.
Full model-consistent BAO/CMB reductions and modern observational constraints.

combination_compatibility.basis: Unchecked beyond the explicitly sourced branch; shared topic membership does not authorize mixing mechanisms.
